user_story: As a benchmark operator I can prepare pinned public repositories offline after one fetch.
expected_behavior: The exact Click and Requests commits have complete source blobs and every arm clones the same commit.
evidence: Commit 25a3c082; red and reference controls passed in .gate/ctx-ab-runs/ctx-ab-20260727T221130Z-7af605ce and local-fast passed on committed HEAD.
repro: Run the private calibration scenario with retries 0 and inspect controls/control.json before either arm.
risk: Partial caches can fail later when a blob is first read.
fix: Use a full mirror and verify or fetch the exact commit before preparing an arm.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: pinned repositories, evaluator controls, and committed-head package gates are green.

user_story: As an operator I can benchmark without writing ctx state into my normal home directory.
expected_behavior: Each run receives an isolated owner-only HOME and temporary directory; authentication is copied with mode 0600 only for the turn and the entire agent home is removed in finally.
evidence: Both arms in .gate/ctx-ab-runs/ctx-ab-20260727T221130Z-7af605ce passed evaluator-isolation.json: network denied, git and project canaries passed, and credential, config, scenario, control, and sibling paths were denied.
repro: Run one private production pair, inspect evaluator-isolation.json for each arm, and verify no auth.json or config.toml remains under the run root.
risk: Persistent credentials or shared user paths can contaminate evidence and expose secrets.
fix: Use a 0700 per-arm home, 0600 credential/config copies, explicit deny rules, and fail-closed cleanup.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: independent security review accepted the isolation boundary and artifact scan.

user_story: As a reviewer I can distinguish recommendation selection and use.
expected_behavior: All candidates are persisted; only policy-selected entities load and only trace-proven entities become used.
evidence: Dry-run summary recommends skill agent and MCP but ctx-light selects only its skill; lifecycle contains only that skill.
repro: Inspect click ctx-light recommendations.json summary.json and lifecycle/events.jsonl in the adaptive dry run.
risk: Treating every recommendation as selected creates fake lifecycle evidence and needless cost.
fix: Persist recommended_ids selected_ids and used_ids separately and drive lifecycle from selected_items.
reviewer_verdict: Pass after fix: candidate and active-context states no longer conflict.

user_story: As a reviewer I can prove which skills MCPs and agents were loaded used and unloaded.
expected_behavior: Light mode loads one skill; full mode loads all three; MCP and agent use require exact runtime evidence; only loaded entities unload.
evidence: Production dry runs .gate/ctx-ab-runs/ctx-ab-20260727T223036Z-1d7e43ad and ctx-ab-20260727T223114Z-0be5b69e record candidates, selection, lifecycle, final empty state, and cache provenance.
repro: Run a dry run and inspect recommendations.json, summary.json, and lifecycle actions for each arm.
risk: Lifecycle-only claims can misrepresent tools the host never supplied or used.
fix: Require selected, delivered, adopted, and used states separately; unload only applied entities.
reviewer_verdict: Pass for protocol and production-catalog wiring; live full runtime proof remains BENCH-011.

user_story: As a product owner I receive honest time and token KPIs.
expected_behavior: Parent and orchestration totals preserve provider-reported input, cache-read, cache-write, uncached, and output tokens; missing provider usage remains unavailable and completeness is explicit.
evidence: Commits 43fda102, 0708979d, 0854ac70, and fc4cf0b9 preserve cumulative usage, cache-read/cache-write detail, history, and failure-as-unavailable behavior; the orchestration checkpoint passed 5140 tests.
repro: Exercise complete, partial, timeout, exception, cache-read, and cache-write provider records, then compare CLI, session history, lifecycle, telemetry, and dashboard totals.
risk: Zero-filling missing usage or dropping cache-write tokens understates cost and invalidates enterprise KPI comparisons.
fix: Use complete-or-null aggregation, persist tokens_reported and cache fields, and keep unavailable provider failures null across every surface.
reviewer_verdict: Pass for truthful shared usage accounting; production benchmark validity remains tracked separately.

user_story: As a product owner I can compare without-ctx and adaptive ctx behavior on the same task.
expected_behavior: Arms share commit, model, task, evaluator, timeout, isolation, and verification; six paired trials alternate baseline-light order three times each and exclude incomplete pairs from efficiency claims.
evidence: Commit 25a3c082 adds explicit two-arm 3/3 counterbalancing, clean-worktree enforcement, immutable scenario and catalog hashes, and paired completeness tests; Click runs are labeled calibration only.
repro: Run six trials from a clean committed harness and inspect the schedule, immutable hashes, performance.json, summary.json, and incidents.csv.
risk: Dirty harnesses, fixed arm order, or asymmetric failures can create a false efficiency result.
fix: Fail closed on dirty state, alternate order, preserve intent-to-treat quality failures, and calculate efficiency only for complete passing pairs.
reviewer_verdict: Pass for benchmark methodology; production benefit evidence remains open in BENCH-008, BENCH-014, and BENCH-021.

user_story: As an operator I get a durable record of failures and bounded retries.
expected_behavior: Failures are logged and later correlated retries resolve them; unresolved incidents fail; light escalates only after a clean model turn and normal verifier exit 1.
evidence: Unit tests cover correlated resolution and timeout/non-test failure non-escalation; adaptive live recovery evidence is pending.
repro: Inject a normal focused-test failure and a timeout then inspect treatment levels and incident statuses.
risk: Silent retries hide instability and timeout escalation activates unnecessary expensive context.
fix: Resolve prior attempt rows after success reject unresolved rows and gate escalation on exact failure kind.
reviewer_verdict: Review blockers fixed in code; live recovery remains.

user_story: As a ctx user I receive useful context without paying for every available tool.
expected_behavior: Host preflight selects at most one bounded skill; MCP and reviewer activate only after explicit evidence; selected context is removed after its useful phase.
evidence: Click calibration ctx-ab-20260727T224009Z-61640368 favored CTX. The six-pair attrs diagnostic ctx-ab-20260727T225929Z-ba9a7a75 preserved quality in all 12 arms and had median ratios 0.946 time, 0.810 total tokens, and 1.143 uncached tokens, so it did not meet the benefit threshold. Parallel edits made that run diagnostic; commit 70dd4917 now rejects start/end repository or manifest drift.
repro: Rerun the identical attrs assignment from committed head, then run six counterbalanced pairs for the remaining private attrs, Requests, and Rich scenarios with exact token and trace evidence.
risk: Generic testing guidance may reduce total context while failing to improve uncached tokens; one scenario also has high stochastic variance.
fix: Keep bounded trace metrics, fail closed on run attestation, analyze command/cache behavior, and require quality non-inferiority plus the predeclared benefit threshold.
reviewer_verdict: Keep open: the first held-out diagnostic was quality-safe but not beneficial; clean identical rerun and multi-repository evidence remain required.

user_story: As a reviewer I get order-balanced results even when scenarios are filtered.
expected_behavior: Each six-trial three-arm block uses every permutation once; each six-trial baseline-light block alternates order exactly three times each.
evidence: Commit 25a3c082; test_three_arm_schedule_is_stable_and_counterbalanced and test_two_arm_schedule_alternates_order_three_times_each pass.
repro: Compare full and filtered three-arm schedules, then assert the two-arm six-trial sequence is baseline-first and CTX-first 3/3.
risk: Resetting scenario indexes or always starting one arm biases timing and cache effects.
fix: Use stable scenario ordering and explicit two-arm alternation.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: both supported schedules are deterministic and counterbalanced.

user_story: As an operator I do not retain detached benchmark or verification processes.
expected_behavior: Timeout and successful-parent paths terminate marked descendants including children that retain pipes and fail closed when cleanup cannot be verified.
evidence: Process-group detached-redirected and detached-inherited-pipe regressions pass; marker cleanup runs in finally and permission failures are contained.
repro: Run both detached descendant regressions and scan recorded PIDs.
risk: Detached children distort elapsed time leak resources or raise before cleanup.
fix: Catch process-group permission failures kill marked descendants before pipe reap and always rescan in finally.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: independent re-review confirmed both containment regressions and no live model dependency remains.

user_story: As a reviewer I can reject an MCP or reviewer claim that used the wrong target or was not closed.
expected_behavior: Full treatment passes only with the expected MCP slug type body and a matching selected-marker spawned waited and closed reviewer ID.
evidence: Unit fixtures reject failed wrong-argument wrong-result unclosed and malicious-review prompts; real MCP protocol preflight passes.
repro: Run one live ctx-full arm and inspect policy_valid tool observations marker and team-token scope.
risk: Tool-name-only evidence can credit the wrong call and completed reviewers can remain allocated.
fix: Bind MCP evidence to exact arguments/result bind agent evidence to selected marker and mark any agent attempt token-incomplete.
reviewer_verdict: Review blocker fixed in code; final live trace pending.

user_story: As a reviewer I can reproduce the exact benchmark schedule and repository state.
expected_behavior: The manifest records trials, retries, timeout, arm mode, filters, cache, schedule, script and scenario hashes, dependencies, catalog provenance, and clean state; live scoring rejects dirty state.
evidence: Commit 25a3c082 and .gate/ctx-ab-runs/ctx-ab-20260727T223114Z-0be5b69e/environment.json record the version-2 cache hit, seven bound runtime files, schedule, hashes, and dirty diagnostic state.
repro: Run a dry run from a dirty tree, inspect environment.json, then confirm the same live command fails before model execution.

fix: Persist the complete manifest and require a clean committed harness for live production runs.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: manifest completeness and dirty-tree fail-closed behavior are independently reviewed.

user_story: As a ctx maintainer I can discover the benchmark from the repository feature inventory.
expected_behavior: The benchmark runner has a user story and evidence row in both canonical and published feature trackers.
evidence: MAINT-016 exists in qa/feature_status.csv and docs/qa/feature-user-story-status.csv; all 12 feature tracker tests pass.
repro: Run .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q src/tests/test_feature_user_story_tracker.py.

reviewer_verdict: Pass: canonical and published rows parse with unique IDs and the maintainer-script coverage gate is green.

user_story: As a product owner I can distinguish controlled context delivery from real-catalog recommendation quality.
expected_behavior: Controlled fixtures prove mechanics; production runs use the shipped graph, availability filtering, exact source-body provenance, and a separate held-out relevance evaluation.
evidence: Commit 25a3c082 binds all seven declared runtime files byte-for-byte to the hashed availability pack on build and cache hit. Dry runs ctx-ab-20260727T223036Z-1d7e43ad and ctx-ab-20260727T223114Z-0be5b69e prove cache miss/hit and selected installable context. A frozen held-out relevance set is still absent.
repro: Freeze private scenarios before CTX inspection, run red/reference controls, then evaluate relevance, availability, source safety, language fit, no-key constraints, and paired outcomes.
risk: Mechanically valid catalog entries can still be irrelevant or overly lexical, and calibration tasks cannot serve as holdouts.
fix: Retain exact source binding and add private held-out assignments across at least three repositories before any broad quality claim.
reviewer_verdict: Keep open: catalog mechanics and provenance pass; held-out multi-repository recommendation and development evidence remains mandatory.

user_story: As a product owner I can compare true elapsed development time rather than selected phases.
expected_behavior: Total time includes clone preparation ctx setup model work verification artifact checks lifecycle unload and session close while phase times remain visible.
evidence: Runner now measures from trial start through lifecycle close and materialization elapsed is included in verification; focused tests and dry run pass.
repro: Compare total_seconds with phase fields and teardown_seconds in an adaptive run.
risk: Excluding ctx teardown or artifact work understates treatment cost.
fix: Measure end-to-end with a monotonic timer and retain setup agent verification and teardown breakdowns.
reviewer_verdict: Reviewer timing gap fixed in code; live values will be captured next.

user_story: As a benchmark reviewer I can trust that a reviewer agent really completed its assigned review.
expected_behavior: Full treatment credits reviewer use only when an error-free selected spawn is followed by a completed non-empty wait and close for the same agent in that order.
evidence: Adversarial fixtures reject completed calls carrying errors and close-wait-spawn ordering; 21 focused tests pass.
repro: Feed observed_agent_review a completed event with a non-null error or reverse the valid spawn-wait-close events.
risk: Set intersection without ordering can falsely certify failed or impossible reviewer traces.
fix: Track each selected reviewer through an ordered spawn-wait-close state machine and ignore every error-bearing event.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: independent recheck closed the P1 with valid error-stage mismatched-ID reverse-order and success probes.

user_story: As a ctx user I do not pay prompt or tool overhead for capabilities that were not selected.
expected_behavior: Baseline and ctx-light explicitly disable multi-agent and expose no ctx MCP configuration; only ctx-full enables both surfaces.
evidence: Command-construction regression checks disable/no-MCP for light and enable/MCP for full; focused gate passes.
repro: Build Codex commands for with_ctx false and true then inspect feature flags and MCP config arguments.
risk: Merely exposing unused agent or MCP schemas can inflate cached context and lets baseline behavior escape the intended policy.
fix: Explicitly disable multi_agent outside full treatment and attach the MCP only to full treatment.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: independent product-path probes confirmed recommendation does not auto-load entities and the old harness forced the expensive surfaces.

user_story: As a host integrator I receive a bounded adaptive activation proposal instead of an instruction to load every candidate.
expected_behavior: context_policy proposes at most one local directly usable skill for immediate load; active baseline external malformed and expensive candidates stay kept manual or deferred.
evidence: Commit 98b3ee7f; 79 adapter tests and the 435-test recommendation/CLI integration slice passed.
repro: Call ctx__recommend_bundle with active baseline external malformed skill agent and MCP rows then inspect keep load deferred and manual.
risk: A naive host can interpret the advisory load list literally and recreate the forced-full slowdown in production.
fix: Load one eligible skill; exclude kept context; defer agents MCPs and secondary skills; fail closed on external or malformed metadata.
reviewer_verdict: Approved after two review rounds and direct adversarial probes.

user_story: As a ctx run user I send only the ctx schemas configured for the current stage of work.
expected_behavior: Fresh runs default to recommend_bundle plus wiki_get; explicit full or allow patterns expose more; prompts and executors match submitted schemas; legacy and overridden resume settings remain durable.
evidence: Commit 743d3f20; default schema payload fell from 13 tools and 12476 bytes to 2 tools and 3660 bytes (70.7 percent); 143 CLI/state and 435 integration tests passed.
repro: Run default full no-ctx MCP-only lifecycle-only legacy resume and full-to-minimal resume probes; compare submitted names prompts execution and session_config.
risk: Repeated unused schemas consume input and cached-context tokens on every model iteration.
fix: Filter schemas before provider submission rebuild instructions from actual definitions preserve legacy full resumes and persist explicit resume overrides.
reviewer_verdict: Approved after three review rounds including exact pre-patch prompt migration.

user_story: As a developer I receive a small ranked skill selection rather than a bulk context merge.
expected_behavior: The legacy CLI defaults to one installed directly mapped skill; fuzzy and graph entities remain suggestions; always_load and explicit broader caps are deterministic and documented.
evidence: Commit bcd2e3a6; 51 resolver tests plus 435 integration tests passed; 20 hash-seed probes selected the same conflict winner.
repro: Run C-language fuzzy unavailable-Docker graph-agent Jest-Vitest conflict invalid-limit and explicit-cap probes.
risk: Bulk or lexical skill injection increases prompt size and can mix conflicting instructions.
fix: Use token-boundary fuzzy matching direct-only single-slot activation deterministic ties and named-selection documentation.
reviewer_verdict: Approved after reviewer reproduced and closed all four findings.

user_story: As a ctx run user I have selected skills, MCPs, and agents activated and unloaded as task evidence changes without exposing every capability up front.
expected_behavior: The host control plane recommends outside model turns; each provider turn receives bounded selected context; lifecycle distinguishes selection, delivery, adoption, use, and unload; final state is empty.
evidence: Commit 70dd4917 records delivery before unload and session_end, hashes the completed ledger, and labels provider semantic attribution as unavailable without promoting delivery to use. Review also proved the current production-catalog engine defers MCPs and agents without a host-owned activation path.
repro: Run held-out private production pairs and require exact lifecycle ordering, cleanup, final empty state, and naturally policy-triggered MCP or reviewer evidence in a separate conformance suite.
risk: Prompt delivery alone does not prove adoption or use, and the current performance engine cannot activate deferred MCP or reviewer candidates.
fix: Implement deny-by-default host-owned deferred activation from public task/run evidence, keep mandatory lifecycle conformance separate from performance claims, and never inject hidden oracle data or forced IDs.
reviewer_verdict: Keep open: skill delivery semantics and cleanup are fixed; deferred MCP/reviewer decision and execution phases plus live conformance evidence remain required.

user_story: As a benchmark reviewer I can prove which provider, model, ctx runtime, source revision, catalog source, and treatment produced every scored result.
expected_behavior: Completed trials and aggregates fail closed unless provider, runtime, harness, scenario, catalog, availability pack, generated runtime files, and treatment provenance are internally consistent.
evidence: Commits a45b6034 and 25a3c082; 90 focused tests cover missing, tampered, mismatched, dirty, and valid provenance. The adversarial installer/source mismatch is rejected and the reviewer returned APPROVE.
repro: Alter provider or runtime attestation, generated runtime file bytes, availability JSON, harness state, or arm treatment and validate the run.
risk: Unattested or falsely bound evidence can measure different code or context while appearing reproducible.
fix: Bind every declared runtime file to source bytes, version cache keys, require clean committed live runs, and exclude unverifiable trials.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: independent adversarial re-review accepted build and cache-hit provenance; efficiency collection remains separately open.

user_story: As a benchmark reviewer I can trust that the model cannot inspect evaluator controls, credentials, sibling prompts, or unrestricted network.
expected_behavior: Each arm proves exact sandbox denies while allowing git and the untouched project regression command; no sensitive artifact survives cleanup.
evidence: Both evaluator-isolation.json files in ctx-ab-20260727T221130Z-7af605ce report verified=true, network canary denied, git=0, project=0, and every sensitive read denied.
repro: Run one production pair and inspect per-arm evaluator-isolation.json plus a post-run sensitive filename scan.
risk: Readable controls leak answers; copied credentials or sibling prompts break security and causal isolation.
fix: Use per-arm 0700 homes, 0600 transient auth, explicit deny paths, loopback canaries, project canaries, and finally cleanup.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: independent security and benchmark reviewers accepted the isolation evidence.

user_story: As a benchmark operator I cannot accidentally publish evidence from changing code.
expected_behavior: Live production execution starts only from a clean committed worktree and records immutable harness and scenario hashes.
evidence: Commit 25a3c082 rejected all five dirty paths before model execution; local-fast passed all 10 lanes with 9 workers in 41.194 seconds; clean canary ctx-ab-20260727T224009Z-61640368 records repository clean=true and an empty tracked diff hash.
repro: Modify one tracked file and run the private live command; it must exit before catalog/model work. Commit, rerun local-fast, and verify all lane return codes are zero before the canary.
risk: Dirty evidence cannot be reproduced or attributed to the merged implementation.
fix: Fail closed on dirty repository state and run all local gates from isolated committed-HEAD worktrees.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: reviewer accepted the gate and the first frozen clean canary exercised it successfully.

user_story: As a benchmark owner I can keep real evaluator tests and reference patches unavailable to agents and public source.
expected_behavior: Historical or held-out scenarios live only in an ignored 0700 directory with 0600 files; tracked scenario packs contain public synthetic examples only.
evidence: The Click historical scenario is absent from tracked benchmarks/ctx_ab/scenarios.yaml and preserved at .gate/ctx-ab-private/scenarios.yaml with directory mode 0700 and file mode 0600; live path validation rejects public, temporary, symlinked, or broad-permission sources.
repro: Search tracked files for the historical scenario ID, inspect private modes, and attempt a live run with the public scenario pack.
risk: Public hidden tests invalidate holdouts and readable local files leak evaluator answers.
fix: Separate calibration from confirmation, enforce private roots and owner-only modes, and deny scenario/control paths in the agent sandbox.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: CTO review closed the tracked-oracle blocker.

user_story: As a product owner I can explain token overhead using measured prompt and tool behavior rather than guesses.
expected_behavior: Every live arm records prompt bytes, command count, failures, total and maximum tool output, oversized output count, repeated command count, messages, and exact terminal token fields.
evidence: Commit 25a3c082 and clean calibration ctx-ab-20260727T224009Z-61640368: CTX emitted 37628 tool-output bytes with a 7876-byte maximum and zero oversized commands; baseline emitted 75802 bytes with one 48718-byte command.
repro: Inject repeated and greater-than-32KiB command outputs into JSONL, then inspect summary metrics and the real calibration trace.
risk: Aggregate token counts alone cannot identify context bloat or distinguish prompt overhead from tool-output amplification.
fix: Persist bounded trace metrics and predeclare a 32KiB per-command ceiling for confirmatory trials.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: forensic reviewer accepted the measurements while correctly rejecting a single-run causal claim.

user_story: As a reviewer I can prove that the runtime guidance hashed in provenance is exactly what the shipped installer generated.
expected_behavior: Every file declared by runtime-availability.json must exist with identical bytes in the installed catalog on build and cache hit; provenance records path, SHA-256, and size.
evidence: Commit 25a3c082; version-2 dry run ctx-ab-20260727T223036Z-1d7e43ad bound seven files and cache-hit run ctx-ab-20260727T223114Z-0be5b69e revalidated them. Adversarial packaged-copy mismatch and tampering regressions pass.
repro: Make the benchmark hash one availability pack while the installer writes different skill bytes; catalog preparation must fail.
risk: A cache can claim a source hash it never consumed, invalidating recommendation provenance.
fix: Compare exact declared bytes to generated files before caching and on every cache read; version the cache schema.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: the same reviewer who found the mismatch re-ran the adversarial proof and returned APPROVE with no blockers.

user_story: As a developer I receive language-specific runtime guidance when my host supplies language as structured context rather than repeating it in prose.
expected_behavior: The normalized language field contributes a retrieval tag, preserves wrong-language filtering, and loads the best available language-specific skill without changing established rankings.
evidence: Commit 48709ca8; attrs dry run ctx-ab-20260727T224932Z-326986c4 reproduced the missing skill, and ctx-ab-20260727T225220Z-f54e573f selected skill:ctx-python-testing for both identical scenarios after the fix. Local-fast then passed all 10 lanes in 44.27 seconds with 5710 unit tests passing.
repro: Recommend for query 'fix and review frozen attrs field setter policy compatibility' with language=python, local_code_task=true, and no_api_keys=true; compare tags, results, and context_policy before and after the commit.
risk: Ignoring structured language can hide relevant skills and make recommendation quality depend on redundant prompt wording.
fix: Normalize the language hint once and append it to retrieval tags before ranking; retain existing availability and wrong-language filters.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: independent reviewer verified graph/index paths, py canonicalization, unchanged golden rankings, and focused recommendation suites.

user_story: As a benchmark reviewer I can trust lifecycle order and know whether the committed harness and environment manifest still match at run completion.
expected_behavior: Delivery precedes unload and session_end; the digest covers terminal events; repository HEAD/diff and the pristine in-memory environment manifest are compared at completion; any mismatch invalidates every efficiency or product claim.
evidence: Commit 70dd4917; 94 benchmark tests and committed-head local-fast passed all 10 lanes in 47.822 seconds with 5715 unit tests passing. Corrected dry runs ctx-ab-20260727T232717Z-5c76ff5e, ctx-ab-20260727T232728Z-c94ea15c, and ctx-ab-20260727T232738Z-57479ff7 report both end attestations true and zero incidents.
repro: Change HEAD or tracked files during a run, tamper valid environment JSON, or alter a dry-run manifest; require a run-attestation incident, nonzero exit, ineligible rows, and product_claim_eligible=false.
risk: Startup-only cleanliness can mislabel evidence if another worker edits or commits during long trials; mutable manifests can preserve false provenance.
fix: Retain the startup manifest in process memory, compare exact serialized bytes at completion, use precise matches-at-end wording, and fail closed for live and dry-run evidence.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: independent adversarial reviewer reproduced five initial findings, verified all corrections, and returned APPROVE with no remaining findings.
